property_summary: For every identifier the reference contract's getPrice view function must not expose the identifier bits as an int256-derived price (it returns no value / zero semantics), whereas the mutant returns an int256 derived from the identifier low 128/256 bits so some identifiers produce a nonzero return — the test checks that calling getPrice via assertionDisputedCallback yields an unchanged view-return of 0 for all identifiers in the reference but can be nonzero in the mutant for some identifiers.
change_summary: Return the low 128 bits of the identifier (cast) as int256 to expose identifier influence on output.
